thread:
Zoe: Pared-down plan for the benchmark launch social push. Need: X teaser image + 2 caption tones, LinkedIn carousel (3 cards), short demo clip (12s), and a follow-up DM template for registrants. Also must tag leads `bench_launch_q3` and route to SDR pool `webinar-ops`. Can someone take creative? @Marc?

Marc: I can own creative. Drop the three topline stats and logo pack. Prefer PNGs and one square clip.

Inez: Stats in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/q3_pack. Toplines: ~60% latency reduction, 2.5x throughput, ~32% cost savings. Logo assets at /assets/logos.

Zoe: Tone: product-focused but accessible. For X lead with a bold stat, LinkedIn tells the story + PM quote. A/B test captions: A) punchy benefit, B) technical-first. Keep X captions <180 chars.

Marc: ETA Wed noon for images + clip. Will include alt text and a version with brand stinger.

Cal: Routing note: I'll create rule to add tag `bench_launch_q3` and map UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_q3&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic; utm_content will differentiate `x_teaser`, `li_carousel`, `clip_story`. Also adding prefill ref=bench_q3.

Queue-bot: Scheduling hint: highest organic engagement windows Mon/Tue 10:30 PT. Console slot free Mon 10:30 PT.

Inez: PM quote approved and dropped in Drive. Also left a short methodology blurb we should surface on slide 2.

Zoe: Quick checklist before scheduling: 1) pick X caption variant; 2) finalize carousel card visuals; 3) confirm short link redirect and GA event; 4) draft DM template. Propose publish Mon 10:30 PT: X teaser + clip; Tue 10:30 PT: LinkedIn carousel + long post; Wed 09:00 PT: X reminder + register CTA.

Marc: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/edits/bench_q3_assets.zip. Includes alt colorway and clip.

Cal: Staging routing test passed at 16:04 PT  sample lead landed in `webinar-ops-staging` with utm_content=x_teaser. Will run prod smoke test post-publish.

Zoe: Draft DM for registrants posted. Short and action-focused.

Marc: Minor creative note  swapping card 2 background to darker gradient for legibility. Uploaded v2.

Zoe: Good call. Decision: start with caption A (benefit-first) and swap if CTR < 1% in 24h. If organic underperforms, flip CTA to "Watch on demand" and pin carousel. Also consider $150/day paid boost on top variant for 48h if CTR stays low.

Queue-bot: Scheduling job queued for Mon 10:30 PT.

Cal: Prod smoke test done after publish at 10:33 PT  test lead reached `webinar-ops` with correct UTMs and ref param. All set.

Zoe: Thanks team  closing thread.
